# LeonardoMD 0.1.370
- Persistent favorites for documents, projects and workspaces, with welcome lists of favorites and recent items. - Choose LeonardoMD as the default application for Markdown documents. - Improved sidebar context menu styling. - Markdown table width comments apply to the next table only; ordinary tables retain natural widths.
Promoted from the signed, notarized beta 0.1.369 after real hosted update, installation and relaunch validation.

# LeonardoMD 0.1.369 Beta
- Save favorite documents, projects and workspaces, with persistent favorites and welcome item lists. - Includes the recent default Markdown application choice, sidebar context menu styling fix and table-width comment support.
Signed and notarized for Apple silicon Macs. Select Beta in Preferences → Updates to receive beta updates.
